name: The Hythe , A Luxury Collection Resort
positioning: The Hythe, a Luxury Collection Resort, Vail: an alpine resort with easy access to the Eagle Bahn Gondola and Lionshead Village, whose design, decor and dining pay homage to Vail's founders and the mountain's 1960s heyday
best_for: Skiers who want easy access to the Eagle Bahn Gondola
Families or groups who want a residence or penthouse
Guests who want recovery-focused spa treatments after days on the mountain

facts.text: The accommodations are scented with sweet spruce and fir aromatherapies.
Most rooms have fireplaces and mountain views.
All rooms have design details that nod to the area's history, including framed 10th Mountain Division pins.
The resort offers residences and penthouses where family and friends can relax together.
The Well & Being Spa offers an Apothecary experience where guests create custom-blended essential oils.
Guests coming from sea level can book an oxygen therapy session at the spa to help acclimate to the altitude.
The spa's self-care lounge has Hyperice massage guns and Normatec leg compression sleeves for sore muscles.
The resort has a four-season pool.
A massive, glass-enclosed fireplace anchors the hotel lobby.
A hallway off the lobby shows a rotating selection of local art, and beyond it is a room of vintage photographs from the 10th Mountain Division and the golden age of skiing.
Margie's Haas is a tribute to Margie Haas, a World War II local home cook who welcomed 10th Mountain Division soldiers into her home.
The lobby bar serves Colorado-crafted whiskey and spirits in partnership with the local distillery 10th Mountain Whiskey & Spirit Company.

highlights.text: Design, decor and dining pay homage to Vail founders Earl Eaton and Pete Seibert and the mountain's 1960s heyday.
The resort has easy access to the Eagle Bahn Gondola, Lionshead Village and Betty Ford Alpine Village.
Suites have whirlpool jet bathtubs and two balconies with mountain views.
The spa has a Himalayan salt lounge guests can enjoy before their treatments.
Complimentary daily moments include fireside s'mores and tastings of locally distilled 10th Mountain Whiskey.

considerations.text: Entry-level rooms are about 300 square feet, so guests who want more space should consider an upgrade.
The rooms do not have a work space.
Pets are limited to two dogs per room and are not permitted in private residences.
